guns_pistol_desc: A light semi-automatic: one round for each pull of the trigger, quick to draw and quick to reload. Middle mouse reloads.
guns_revolver_desc: Six heavy rounds and a kick like a mule. Slow to fire, slower to reload, and it hits hard.
guns_dualpistols_desc: A pistol in each hand, firing in turns. Wild at long range, deadly up close.
guns_smg_desc: A small automatic that empties its magazine in two seconds. Light, fast and not very accurate once the barrel climbs.
guns_shotgun_desc: A pump-action that throws a spread of pellets. Devastating close up, useless far off. Rounds load one at a time, and you can fire in between.
guns_rifle_desc: A bolt-action hunting rifle: five rounds, one careful shot at a time. Accurate when you aim.
guns_leveraction_desc: A cowboy's rifle: ten rounds in the tube, a quick flick of the lever between shots. Rounds load one at a time.
guns_ar15_desc: A semi-automatic rifle with a thirty-round magazine and a red-dot sight. Fast, accurate and steady.
guns_sniper_desc: A heavy bolt-action with a scope. Hold the block button to look through it: one round hits for a great deal, from very far away.
guns_machinegun_desc: Fires for as long as you hold the attack button. Hold it long and the barrel climbs: short bursts stay accurate.
guns_minigun_desc: Six rotating barrels and a belt of four hundred rounds. It takes a moment to spin up, then it never stops. Slows you down.
guns_flamethrower_desc: A tank of fuel and a long nozzle: hold the trigger for a roaring stream of fire. Whatever it touches catches fire and keeps burning after you stop. Reaches about seven metres. It never sets buildings alight.
guns_empty: Empty: pull the trigger to reload
guns_server_missing: Quad's Guns isn't installed on this server: the guns can't be crafted here.
